slot_note: re-root of task4 after architecture 4 was landed on the platform; new world (Sweden, Småland, a road haulier), new dataset (a battery-electric pilot's duty-day telematics and a terminal weighbridge log), new shell (how-many | please | docx+xlsx)
niche: fleet electrification of a road haulier's regular duties: a battery-electric tractor's energy on a cold day forecast from a pilot's telematics, where the load each pilot day carried is known only as the shipper declared it; client task type regression, classification and model diagnostics
answer: Order 8 battery-electric tractors, for V02, V03, V05, V09, V11, V14, V16 and V18; V07, V21, V24, V27, V30 and V33 stay on diesel
analyst_test: The careful but hurried pass is the union of the four recorded runs' methods: it cleans every file, takes each pilot declaration to the terminal's weighed-on-declared line, carries the tare and the drops, curves the cold, fits squared speed at the year's ratio and a straight-line battery loss with tractor and cold terms, and computes then sets aside the within-duty slope (2.3), the same months a year apart (2.8) and the first-year-only loss (4.3). It files a payload term of 1.5 (the line pulls the pilot's part loads toward the terminal's full loads), a loss of 3.1 and a 445 kWh limit, energies 10 to 20 kWh high, and orders 5 (V02, V14, V18 out); at the design-day speed it orders 10 (V07, V21 in).
domain_test: The results are a regression slope on a covariate the pilot records only as third-party declarations, whose calibration does not transport between the terminal's full-load runs and the pilot's regional part loads (classical error: the error model transports, the line does not); a capacity-fade curve read from an energy-per-SOC proxy net of a reversible cold effect; and a speed extrapolation through a weather-dependent ratio. With nurses and shifts in place of tractors and loads there is no declared weight, no battery and no air drag; the call stops making sense.

driver: A fitted model is carried to new units through three estimates the old units' records support only after diagnostics: a slope on a covariate known through third-party reports whose error model transfers between two populations but whose calibration line does not, because the populations' true levels differ; a permanent decline whose early part a straight line misses and a checks-at-a-year-apart reading confirms wrongly; and a speed set by a planned figure corrected at the design condition rather than on average.
driver_concrete: Each Värnamo duty's January design-day energy is forecast from the Jönköping pilot: the pilot's regional duties carry 75 to 89 per cent of the loads the same shippers declare at Värnamo, so each pilot duty's loads come from its own declarations with the shipper's declaration error read on the Värnamo weighbridge (payload term 1.9; the terminal's line gives 1.5, and Gränna Dryckes' scale days confirm the duties' own loads); the batteries lose 4.6 per cent in the first year, most of it in the first four months (a straight line gives 3.1, the same months a year apart 2.8); each duty runs at 0.76 of the routing tool's speed at -5 C (0.89 over the year).
stump: The careful pass (the union of the recorded runs) orders 5, pricing V02, V14 and V18 at 450 kWh against its own 445 kWh limit; at the design-day speed it orders 10 (V07, V21 in on a payload term of 1.5); each of the three estimates put right alone still orders wrongly (2, 3 or 10 duties); only all three land the eight.
deep_chain: (1) the payload term from each pilot duty's own loads, the declaration error transported from the weighbridge; (2) the first-year loss on a curved age form net of the cold; (3) the energies at the -5 C speed ratio with each duty's combination and load share; (4) the verdicts; (5) the order.
judgment: three estimates each needing diagnostics the runs named and did not run: the calibration's transfer between depots (the pilot's part loads), the early-life loss behind a straight line and a year-apart check, and the winter speed; the within-duty slope the runs computed and dismissed agrees with the first
one_fact_test: each of the three most useful sentences rescues at most 1 of 5 results (effort.py); each leaves the order wrong (2, 3 or 10 duties)

differentiation.mark140: mark140 solves a residual guarantee jointly with a dependent service's load estimated from its own two drivers; nothing here is a residual or a dependency: the quantity is a regression slope whose covariate is recorded by third parties with source-specific error, recovered by calibrating each source on a second record that weighs the truth
differentiation.mark262: mark262 de-attenuates one slope by a single classical noise variance carried from a selected subsample to the population; here there is no selected subsample and no variance to carry: each shipper's declarations err in a different structure (classical, Berkson, exact), identified from the direction of the declared-weighed regression on the weighbridge, so the one pooled reliability correction mark262's route takes is itself a wrong rung
differentiation.mark249: mark249 recovers each unit's gain against references that agree only partly hour by hour by matching spreads; here the units are not calibrated against references: the fitted model's covariate is replaced by its expected true value given its source and its record
differentiation.task4: Same world by the client's instruction to keep the data package; architecture 8 added three register joins the runs made on sight and both runs landed it. Architecture 9 removes the ePTO term and moves the work into the runs' recorded blind spots: the terminal's calibration line does not transport to the pilot's part loads (the within-duty slope the runs dismissed agrees with the transported error model), the battery's early-life loss behind a straight line and a year-apart check, and the winter speed; each alone leaves the order wrong.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a count of alerts each unit raises when its departure from an estimate built from its nearest other units passes a limit set from that departure's past spread; when some units leave, the remaining units' estimates come from farther units and their departures spread wider while their limits stay at the spread measured with the old neighbours, so the alerts rise even as the units fall.

The network re-run is now the first rung of architecture 2.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a count of alerts a less sensitive limit will raise, read from a record the current limit produced: every fault the current limit caught was repaired within days, so the record holds those faults cut short below the higher limit they would otherwise have reached, and the count is the record re-run on the units and estimate sources the next period will have plus one alert for every caught fault the re-run never alerted before its repair.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is each node's share of the units that passed through it unrecorded, when which node an unrecorded unit passed is itself unrecorded: the plan of record assigns every unit a node, but on the nights one node overflowed part of its flow went through a second node and was handled there by hand, so that night's unrecorded units belong partly to each and only the batch a unit was unloaded in at its destination, whose recorded members all passed one node, says which; charged by the plan the overflowing node carries the second node's misses, and charged by the nights' excess over its usual rate the overflowing node sheds the misses its own overload caused.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is what handing a set of members of shared sequences to an outside provider saves, the time the sequences would no longer take: a member the sequence passes through on its way to others saves only its own stops beyond the direct run between its neighbours, and on a branch the near member saves the branch only when the members beyond it go too, so pricing each member at the time its own stops and the run into them take credits passed-through members with travel the sequences still make and, member by member, keeps the near member of a branch.
lineage.stump: A competent solver prices each offered district at the van time its stops take and hands Leenane and Letterfrack to the courier with Mulranny, Achill, Bangor Erris, Belmullet, Louisburgh and Ballycastle, claiming about EUR 20,000; the Connemara van drives through Leenane and Letterfrack to reach Clifden, which stays, so they save only their own stops, and the solver who prices the run without them but one district at a time keeps Mulranny and Bangor Erris, which end the Achill and Erris runs once Achill and Belmullet go: only every combination priced on the run hands over Mulranny, Achill, Bangor Erris, Belmullet, Louisburgh and Ballycastle, about EUR 50,000 net in 2027.
